english.title: Master of ship liable to forfeiture / examination fail to bring the ship to when required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the master of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP..), liable to

(A)_[forfeiture]_
